text: Players must only be outdoors today.

WHISPER ONLY INDOORS: My darlings, the sunshine is far too fragile for your voices. If you step outside, you will speak only in whispers for as long as you remain there. Indoors, you may be as loud and dramatic as you please.
Outdoors, no one may speak above a whisper.
You must slap someone today before 20:00
You must be in your underwear today
Speak only kindly of others; stay within sight of someone.
COMPLIMENTS ONLY, EYES UP: For this turn, every sentence you say to another person must open with a genuine compliment about them, no exceptions.
Stay on the ground floor until 20:00
Everyone must be in the Dining Hall at 12:00.
You must carry a light when outside.
Nobody may speak to anyone wearing a hat.
Everyone must hum while in the kitchen.
